full_judgment: In view of the discussion above, the impugned judgment cannot be sustained and is, accordingly, set aside. The judgment and decree of the courts below are restored. Plaintiffs do get khas possession of the suit premises by evicting the defendant therefrom in accordance with law. The appeal is allowed without any order as to cost.
